description: Department of Local Government - North Central Province - The meeting for the Purpose of the election the Chairman for the Dimbulagala Pradeshiya Sabha of Polonnaruwa Districe
categorisation: This gazette notice announces the schedule for a meeting to elect the Chairman of the Dimbulagala Pradeshiya Sabha. It is a notice made under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance and specifically relates to an electoral process at the local government level. This fits the definition of Type 7 (Elections Gazettes), which covers "Election announcements and schedules" and "Electoral commission appointments and decisions."
